steps.instruction: Put 8 ounces butter or margarine, 4 ounces sugar and 6 ounces treacle in a saucepan.
Stir over low heat until the butter or margarine and sugar have melted.
Add 8 ounces each of oats and self-rising flour, and 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Press the mixture into two well-greased 7-inch round cake tins.
Bake in the center of the oven for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake in the center of the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Mark the top into slices while it is still warm.
Let it cool almost completely in the tin before removing it.
